bias.en: Bearish · reclaimed the May low, testing $324–326
bias.zh: 偏空 · 收复 5 月低点，测试 $324–326

read.en: Teradyne rose 4.8% on Oct 27 to $323.68, trading between $312.28 and $328.77 on 1.4 times average volume. It is above the falling 5-day average ($319.2), below the falling 10-day ($329.6), 30-day ($374.6) and 100-day ($377.0) and the rising 200-day ($348.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($347.93), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月27日上涨 4.8%，收于 $323.68，盘中区间 $312.28–328.77，成交量为均量的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$319.2）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$329.6）、30 日（$374.6）和 100 日均线（$377.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$348.5）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$347.93），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $309.4 May 19 low and the $320 Oct 26 high, now support, but stalled under $326. Resistance is $322.3–326.4 (Oct 20 and September lows), then $328.8–329.6 (Oct 27 high, 10-day) and $347.9–348.5 (SAR, 200-day). Support is $319.2–320 (5-day, Oct 26 high), then $309.4 and $304.3–306.4. A close above $329.6 would target $348; below $319, $309.
